clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim awaits a wolf heart from across the sea. Apothecary Zinge sends it from the Undercity to support the Forsaken's research in central Kalimdor.

Apothecary Zinge sends a Wolf Heart Sample from the Undercity to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens. The Royal Apothecary Society's experiments reach beyond the ruins of Lordaeron. After Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine sent tainted organs, Zinge sought to extend their research across the world. Now a courier carries the sample overseas to Helbrim, an alchemist stationed in the Barrens' dry savanna.

At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim studies how Kalimdor's native beasts react to compounds from the Plaguelands. The wolf heart could show how those toxins affect local creatures. Helbrim believes that dissecting and testing it alongside them will help the Forsaken master poisons and unnatural afflictions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor. He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads. To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar. Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have a package for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.
This is a welcome delivery, friend. Your reward is well earned.
